title: Double Charge on Subscription

customer_profile.name: Jordan Chen
customer_profile.opening_message: Hi, I just noticed I was charged twice for my monthly subscription this month. I see two charges of $29.99 on my credit card dated January 15th. Can you help me with this?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will be satisfied with just the refund and timeline, but delighted if offered goodwill gesture
escalation_triggers: Being asked to repeat information multiple times
customer_profile.personality_notes: Customer is cooperative and focused on getting the duplicate charge corrected efficiently.

checkpoints.description: Thank the customer for bringing this to attention
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Thank the customer for bringing this to your attention to set a positive tone.

checkpoints.description: Verify the account using last 4 digits of card or email
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Verify the account (last 4 digits or email) before discussing billing details.

checkpoints.description: Confirm you can see the duplicate charge in the system
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Confirm you can see the duplicate charge in your system before taking action.

checkpoints.description: Apologize for the inconvenience caused by the error
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Apologize for the inconvenience caused by the duplicate charge.
Consider: Confirm you are processing the refund now and state what will happen next.

checkpoints.description: Provide timeline for refund to appear (3-5 business days)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Provide the expected timeline for the refund to appear (3–5 business days).

checkpoints.description: Offer any goodwill gesture (e.g., one week free extension)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer a small goodwill gesture (like a one-week extension) to reinforce loyalty.

common_mistakes_to_watch: Not verifying the account before discussing details
Making the customer wait while 'checking with supervisor' for obvious errors
Not apologizing for the company's error

scenario_context: Customer has been subscribed for 8 months. This is a legitimate duplicate charge due to a system glitch. Refund is authorized per policy.
